heading: Get started
desc: Airship runs alongside your project without adding anything to the codebase.
compat: Airship uses the authentication you already have configured for Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode

steps.title: Start your app the way you always do.
steps.note: Works with Vite, Next, Remix, Rails, or anything that serves HTML over HTTP. No plugins required.

steps.title: Point Airship at your dev server.
steps.note: Airship connects to the port you're already running and opens the visual editor.

steps.title: Bring your coding agent.
steps.note: Pick the agent you already use and start making changes without running a separate agent interface.
